resources.string: Every conversation has an AI cost. We’re working to fund more free minutes so more people can learn with Mural.
Start talking. You can sign in whenever you like to keep your remaining minutes with your account.
We couldn’t check your minutes. Check your connection and try again. Your allowance hasn’t been reset.
Sign in to return to your minutes. This device has already claimed its welcome allowance.
Your available minutes are used up. Add more when purchases are available, or use your own API key in Settings.
We still need to move your remaining guest minutes to your account. Check again to finish. Your remaining minutes will be added to any minutes you buy.
Purchases aren’t available yet. You can use your own API key.
Sign in to keep your remaining guest minutes with your account. Your learning stays on this device.
By continuing, you confirm you’re 18 or older.
This account has already received its welcome minutes, so it won’t receive a second allowance. Your account balance is unchanged.
